comment: Not in the local copy: it holds only the Europe PMC abstract, which has no video legends. However, in Phase A I fetched the publisher page (nature.com/articles/nmeth.2973), and its supplementary video legend 'Activating Moonwalker neurons with TrpA1' showed both sentences with the same words: 'Thermogenetic activation of moonwalker neurons induces backwards walking.' and 'Genotype was VT50660-Gal4; UAS-TrpA1.' (italics only). The quote is likely genuine at the video-legend part of the locator. The Fig. 2c part of the locator could not be checked (paywalled).
